meta.title: NPC or Main Character?
meta.instructions: A scenario pops up: is that NPC behavior or main character energy? Tap a side or swipe left or right. Right calls refill your plot armor, wrong calls rip a chunk off, and it drains faster every second. Fast calls and streaks multiply your clout. Survive 60 seconds.

do.to: shuffle(concat(map(content_npc, s => {text: s, main: false}), map(content_main, s => {text: s, main: true})))

then.to: if c.main then pick(content_main_stamps) else pick(content_npc_stamps)

node.text: = if time_left < 2000.0 then 'PLOT ARMOR: CRITICAL' else 'PLOT ARMOR'

node.color: = if stamp_ok then (if last_dir > 0 then $secondary else $primary) else $danger

node.text: = if now < 5000 then 'tap a side, or swipe left or right' else str(max(0, ceil((60000 - now) / 1000.0))) + 's until the season finale'

children.text: = if status == 'won' then 'MAIN CHARACTER' else 'PLOT ARMOR: GONE'
= get_or(content_end_lines, min(4, score / 12000), 'You ARE the plot.')

art.style: Tabloid sticker pop: sunny halftone yellow, pink candy stripes, comic bursts, a white scenario card, a sleepy robot NPC button and a spotlit main-character button.

npc: Says “you too” when the waiter says enjoy your meal
Stands up when the bus is still four stops away
Waves back at someone waving at the person behind them
Has 47 tabs open and is using one of them
Says “busy day, huh?” to everyone in the elevator
Pushes the door that clearly says pull. Twice.
Laughs at the joke a full minute after everyone else
Walks laps around the kitchen while on the phone
Comments 'first' on a video from six years ago
Starts every voice note with “so basically”
Stops dead in the doorway to decide where to go
Holds the door from so far away you have to jog
Says “it is what it is” three times in one chat
Keeps the default ringtone at max volume
main: Stares out a rainy bus window like it is a music video
Walks in slow motion after a fresh haircut
Narrates their own grocery run in their head
Drinks iced coffee in the middle of a snowstorm
Gets a dramatic gust of wind at exactly the right time
Changes the playlist so it matches the sunset
Turns a walk to the mailbox into a full montage
Writes in a journal at the cafe window, on purpose
Has a theme song for folding laundry
Rides a bike with no hands and a baguette
Turns around slowly when someone says their name
Gives a toast at a casual Tuesday pizza night
Sips tea calmly while the group chat argues
Befriends a random dog and leaves with a best friend
Wears sunglasses indoors for the plot
Looks back over their shoulder before leaving the party
end_lines: You are an extra in your own episode. Rewrite the script.
Side character with a lot of potential. Get a haircut, walk slowly.
Fan favorite. People are making edits of you.
Season finale energy. The camera follows you now.
You are the plot. Everyone else is a cameo.
